claim: Apple reported no less than $31.0B of operating income for Q3 2023.
summary: Apple's reported operating income for Q3 2023 was well below $31.0B, so the claim that it was no less than $31.0B is false.

sub_claims.text: Apple reported no less than $31.0B of operating income for Q3 2023.
sub_claims.stated_text: no less than $31.0B of operating income for Q3 2023
sub_claims.note: From model knowledge, Apple fiscal Q3 2023 ended July 1, 2023 with revenue ~$81.8B and operating income in low $20Bs (~$22-23B), and calendar Q3 2023 fiscal Q4 2023 also below $27B; both well below $31.0B.
